title: Dependency Management knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the main idea of “Dependency Management”?
options: It makes versioning, input validation, and testing unnecessary.
It means all Kotlin libraries and platform APIs behave identically.
It removes the need to understand types or runtime behavior.
Build reproducibility depends on the Gradle Wrapper, compatible plugin/toolchain versions, declared dependency scopes, and repeatable test/build commands.
questions.answer_key: Build reproducibility depends on the Gradle Wrapper, compatible plugin/toolchain versions, declared dependency scopes, and repeatable test/build commands.
questions.explanation: The reliable answer is grounded in the lesson’s main principle: Build reproducibility depends on the Gradle Wrapper, compatible plugin/toolchain versions, declared dependency scopes, and repeatable test/build commands. Review the example and one relevant edge case before moving on.

questions.prompt: Which learning/debugging practice is most reliable for “Dependency Management”?
options: Ignore warnings and suppress failures before identifying the cause.
Assume the compiler or toolchain is broken without reducing the example.
Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
Change several unrelated parts at once and keep the result that looks plausible.
questions.answer_key: Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
questions.explanation: A minimal reproducible example and version-aware testing separate a real behavior from a mistaken assumption. Review the example and one relevant edge case before moving on.

questions.prompt: Which claim should a learner avoid when applying “Dependency Management”?
options: Treat draft or experimental features as universally stable.
The newest version of every plugin and library is always mutually compatible.
Expose every internal implementation detail to every caller.
Never inspect the official API reference for the selected target.
questions.answer_key: The newest version of every plugin and library is always mutually compatible.
questions.explanation: The misconception to avoid is: The newest version of every plugin and library is always mutually compatible. Review the example and one relevant edge case before moving on.
